n1.speaker: al
n1.text: Have you ever had a part-time job? I've just started one at the campus café.

translations.fa: تا حالا کار پاره‌وقت داشتی؟ من تازه تو کافهٔ دانشگاه شروع کردم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I worked in a restaurant back home for two years.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، تو کشور خودم دو سال تو یه رستوران کار کردم.

branches.suggestion: No, never. How did you get it?

n2.speaker: al
n2.text: I saw an advert on the noticeboard last week. I've already done three shifts!

translations.fa: هفتهٔ پیش یه آگهی رو تابلوی اعلانات دیدم. تا حالا سه شیفت کار کردم!

branches.suggestion: How have you found it so far?

cultureNote.en: British vs American: advert / ad (UK) = commercial / ad (US). "Noticeboard" (UK) = bulletin board (US).

n3.speaker: al
n3.text: Busy but fun. Yesterday I made about two hundred coffees. I've never been so tired!

translations.fa: شلوغ ولی باحال. دیروز حدود دویست تا قهوه درست کردم. تا حالا این‌قدر خسته نشده بودم!

branches.suggestion: I've worked as a barista before, actually.

n4.speaker: al
n4.text: Not yet — we get paid monthly. They're still looking for someone for weekends. Have you got a National Insurance number?

translations.fa: هنوز نه — ماهانه حقوق می‌گیریم. هنوز دنبال یه نفر برای آخر هفته‌ان. شمارهٔ بیمهٔ ملی داری؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I got it last month.
No. What is it, and how do I get one?

cultureNote.en: You need a National Insurance (NI) number to work in the UK. It's used for tax and the State Pension.
cultureNote.fa: برای کار در بریتانیا شمارهٔ NI لازم است.

n5.speaker: al
n5.text: You need it for tax. Anyway, I've told the manager about you — she's free at three if you want a chat.

translations.fa: برای مالیات لازمه. به هر حال، دربارهٔ تو به مدیر گفتم — ساعت سه وقتش آزاده اگه بخوای گپ بزنی.

branches.suggestion: Thanks, Al. I owe you one.

n6.speaker: al
n6.text: No worries. Just don't steal my best shifts!

translations.fa: خواهش. فقط بهترین شیفت‌هام را ازم نگیر!
